query: Which ocean borders the country whose capital is Lisbon?
answer:
Lisbon is the capital of Portugal, and Portugal is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean, which runs along its western and southern coasts. Lisbon sits on the north bank of the Tagus River, where the river opens into the Atlantic. It is the westernmost capital in continental Europe and the only one on the Atlantic coast [1][2][3].
